cohort: The study included 1527 late preterm infants, divided into three groups based on gestational age: 34-34+6/7 weeks, 35-35+6/7 weeks, and 36-36+6/7 weeks.
finding: The rate of respiratory disorders, sepsis, feeding disorders, abnormal neurological examination, and length of NICU hospitalization in late preterm infants was inversely proportional to their gestational age.
